gloss: passage; verse; a line (of a song)

definitions.gloss: passage; verse; a line (of a song)
definitions.explanation: A short passage from a longer text, poem, song or speech, usually when it is quoted.

examples.english: To read a passage from a poem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一節|いっせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}ずさむ→口ずさむ：18513_kuchizusamu⟧。
examples.english: To hum a line from a favorite song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{聖書|せいしょ}→聖書：17969_seisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一節|いっせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}した→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of his speech, he quoted a passage from the Bible.
